t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop web section as a flat straight-on UI mockup in Swiss International Typographic Style on warm limestone. Top: a small sans eyebrow, a large light-weight sans headline and a one-line definition. Below, a strict grid of four columns by two rows of square-cornered tiles alternating deep navy and outlined limestone. Upper tiles: a huge light numeral with slash and a short name; lower tiles: a lead line and short notes for <CONTENT>. A faint steel-blue line drawing of a skid breaks the grid at the right edge. Flat, no shadows.
signature_idea: Service tiers as a Swiss checkerboard of slash-numbered columns, top tile naming the plan, bottom tile pricing it.
